comment: Registry of collectible bundles. Single source of truth for (a) the SharedAssemblyPolicy excludedExactMatches (assembly name = pluginAssembly minus .dll) so the bundle loads into its own collectible ALC instead of the shared parent, and (b) the load-time lint in BundleHost. Every bundle under project/bundles/<id>/ with a pluginAssembly MUST have an entry here.
